pains.hypothesis: Scaling the ingestion pipeline horizontally across clusters presents complex architectural and operational demands for a small engineering team.
Maintaining the free self-hosted Community Edition creates non-revenue-generating support overhead that risks pulling engineering resources away from paying SaaS customers.
Plausible faces constant positioning hurdles having to persuade prospective customers to pay for analytics when Google Analytics provides standard web analytics for free.
Ad blockers blocking Plausible's script by default lead to data underreporting concerns and increased customer support inquiries.
